PHYSICAL EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Map Reading Skills ● Map interpretation ● Map orientation ● Use of orienteering : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Map Reading Skills ● Map interpretation ● Map orientation ● Use of orienteering .
   B. Damage equipment used for Map Reading Skills ● Map interpretation ● Map orientation ● Use of orienteering .
   C. Refuse all feedback on Map Reading Skills ● Map interpretation ● Map orientation ● Use of orienteering .
   D. Practise Map Reading Skills ● Map interpretation ● Map orientation ● Use of orienteering  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Pole Vault Phases ● Approach ● Plant ● Take off ● Swing-up ● Extension ● Fly-awa: (1 mark)
